edit.description: Fold `directive_members_from_resolved`'s two loops into one: the built-in branch (keyed by name, declared syntax read off `builtin_defs`) and the custom branch (name and syntax read off the `CustomKind`) build an identical `graph::DirectiveMember` over `uaf.units.iter().zip(&uaf.features)`. Chain the two sources into one iterator of (kind name, declared syntax, `&KindUnitsAndFeatures`) and keep one `DirectiveMember` literal in the function.

summary: `directive_members_from_resolved` builds a `DirectiveMember` in two loops, and the custom-kind copy is the one no fixture covers.

tests.asserts: the built-in corpus's directive classing is unchanged — a `CLAUDE.md` `@import` still resolves to member, repo file, or one `graph.directive-unbacked` finding

`an_unbacked_pointer_warns_without_failing_the_run` and `a_cross_kind_ring_reaches_the_acyclicity_gate` still pass — both drive a real run through the folded construction, the ring's middle hop being a kind that declares no directive syntax of its own

acceptance: `cargo test` green with no test edited, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean, and the `graph::DirectiveMember` literal appears exactly once in `src/compose.rs`.
notes: Blocked on KIND-READ-NAMES-THE-ONE-KIND-IT-WAS-HANDED for file-disjointness only — both edit src/compose.rs. No fixture declares a custom kind carrying the `directives` primitive (rg over tests/it), so the custom copy is live-but-uncovered; the fold puts it on the built-in path's coverage instead of buying a second fixture. scoped at 5f93bd62
